```python
import random

# Generate half of the palindrome randomly
half_palindrome = ''.join(random.choices('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', k=127))

# Create the full palindrome by reversing the first half and concatenating with the second part
full_palindrome = half_palindrome + half_palindrome[::-1]

print(full_palindrome)
```
